errors.evidence: The description uses the word "общини" (municipalities), but the corresponding label on the x-axis is "Общо" (Total).
The description claims the x-axis categories are in alphabetical order, but "Общо", "Градове", "Села" is not an alphabetical arrangement.

errors.text_span: Оста отляво показва процентно съотношение на всяко от източниците на отопление, маркирана като „Общо“, „Градove“ и „Села“.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the left (Y) axis is marked with the labels "Общо", "Градove", and "Села". These are the labels for the horizontal (X) axis.
The description of the vertical axis scale states it marks every integer, which is unclear. The axis has labeled ticks at intervals of 10 percent (0, 10, 20, etc.), not for every integer value.

This is a stacked bar chart. 62.8% is the value of the "Дърва" (Wood) segment within the "Села" (Villages) bar, not the value of a whole bar itself. The description misrepresents a segment as an entire bar.

errors.text_span: най-ниската стълба, представляваща „Изгаряне на енергийни горива“, е 0.2%
errors.evidence: The description identifies the lowest value with "Изгаряне на енергийни горива", a category from the text list on the left, which is not a category in the chart's legend. The legend categories corresponding to the 0.2% segments are "Газ" and "Отопление от централен източник". It also misidentifies a segment as a "стълба" (bar).

errors.text_span: Всяка стълба е с различен цвят и съответства на дадения източник на отопление.
errors.evidence: This is a stacked bar chart. Each bar is composed of multiple colored segments representing different heating sources, not a single color.

errors.text_span: Стълбата за „Конвенционално ел. отопление“ се разделя на две части, показващи „Търмопомпено ел. отопление“ и „Общо конвенционално ел. отопление“.
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain any bar or segment labeled "Конвенционално ел. отопление" or "Търмопомпено ел. отопление". These terms are taken from the separate text list on the left and are not plotted in the bar chart.

The description fails to identify the chart as a stacked bar chart, which is its fundamental structure. This leads to numerous other errors in describing its components. It also does not mention the legend or map the colors to their corresponding categories.
